title: LG32-Q35-TAGBANK: linear classical staging, pure time6.831, quantum.5 and copies.35

claims.statement: For the single LG32-Q35-TAGBANK physical algorithm and fixed configuration supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md, for every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), whole-secret recovery has unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies, jointly on every execution branch with time O(2^((6831/1000)*sqrt(n))), ordinary classical space O(n), full allocated quantum space O(2^((1/2)*sqrt(n))) and total acquired copies O(2^((7/20)*sqrt(n))). All failures, rejects, discarded inputs, retries, caps, aborts, initialization, exact overflow repair, source moves and output-first cleanup are included, with absolute constants. The time upper envelope has exact growth index1/2.
